semantic_fragments.content: 10.1.1 X-radiation measurement: Maximum allowable radiation is 36 pA/kg (5 μSv/h) (0.5 mR/h). Measurements are made at a distance of 5 cm from any surface to which OPERATOR (other than SERVICE PERSONNEL) can gain access without a TOOL, is deliberately provided with means of access, or is instructed to enter regardless of whether or not a TOOL is needed to gain access.

Clauses 9.7.5 through 9.8.5 and 10.1.1-10.1.2 are all marked N/A in this report, indicating that the device under test (Report No. ETX202303-07-078-02) does not have pressure vessels, pressure-relief devices, patient/operator support or suspension systems, tensile safety factor requirements, systems without mechanical protective devices, or X-radiation producing components that require evaluation under these clauses of IEC60601-1.
